title: Influence Is the Target-Response Jacobian Times Residuals
abstract: arXiv:2610.27689v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We introduce the target-response Jacobian $J = [\partial \hat y_i/\partial y_j]$, which measures how model predictions respond to changes in individual training targets. $J$ complements training-data attribution (TDA) methods, which characterize sensitivity to the weights placed on training observations in the loss rather than to their targets, and can be computed matrix-free at the same cost as influence-based TDA methods. We show that sample-weight influence $\mathcal{I}$ and $J$ follow from the same implicit differentiation argument and differ only by a per-example multiplier: for pointwise losses, $\mathcal{I} = J\operatorname{diag}(m)$ exactly at any stationary point with an invertible Hessian. For canonical-link losses (squared error, logistic, Poisson) the multiplier is the training residual, $\mathcal{I} = J\operatorname{diag}(r)$, and softmax cross-entropy obeys a multiclass version. translated_title: 影响力即目标响应雅可比矩阵与残差之积
translated_abstract: 我们引入了目标响应雅可比矩阵 J = [∂ŷ_i/∂y_j]，它衡量模型预测对单个训练目标值变化的响应程度。J 补充了训练数据归因（TDA）方法——后者刻画的是对损失函数中赋予训练观测的权重（而非其目标值）的敏感性——并且 J 可以以与基于影响力的 TDA 方法相同的计算成本进行无矩阵计算。我们证明样本权重影响力 I 和 J 源自相同的隐式微分论证，两者仅相差一个逐样本乘子：对于逐点损失，在任何具有可逆 Hessian 矩阵的驻点处，I = J diag(m) 精确成立。对于典型连接损失（平方误差、逻辑斯蒂、泊松），该乘子即为训练残差，即 I = J diag(r)，而 softmax 交叉熵则满足一个多类别版本。该恒等式预测了影响力……
tldr: 论文证明了样本权重影响力与目标响应雅可比矩阵之间仅差一个逐样本乘子的精确恒等关系，且对于典型连接损失该乘子正是训练残差，从而将训练数据归因与模型对训练目标值的敏感性统一起来。
en_tdlr: The paper establishes an exact identity showing that sample-weight influence equals the target-response Jacobian times a per-example multiplier—which is precisely the training residual for canonical-link losses—thereby unifying training-data attribution with sensitivity to training targets.
